summary: 858 Partners is a restaurant-technology investment and go-to-market advisory firm founded in 2022 by former Olo executives Marty Hahnfeld (ex-Olo CRO) and Juan George (former Olo SVP Enterprise Sales).

858 Partners runs curated restaurant-technology showcases, including one with Nation's Restaurant News, featuring front- and back-of-house vendors recommended to growing restaurant brands. (Scope note: 858 Partners is an advisory/GTM firm, not itself a software vendor competing directly with Genius products.)
